import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

root=Path('/workspace/e02-B-current-cas-generation')
p='policy-engine/docs/research/e02-cloud-test-plan/implementation-handoffs/B/current-cas-b149-b155-adjudication/review.json'
head=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=root,text=True).strip()
tree=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse',head+'^{tree}'],cwd=root,text=True).strip()
b=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',head+':'+p],cwd=root)
d=json.loads(b)
seen=set()
for group in [d['source_points'],d['receipt_points']]:
 for item in group.values():
  path,ref=item['ref'].rsplit('@',1)
  raw=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',ref+':'+path],cwd=root)
  assert len(raw)==item['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==item['sha256']
  seen.add(item['ref'])
for item in d['historical_controls']:
 spec=item['junit'];path,ref=spec['ref'].rsplit('@',1)
 raw=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',ref+':'+path],cwd=root)
 assert len(raw)==spec['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==spec['sha256']
 seen.add(spec['ref'])
assert d['closure_ids']==[] and d['held_unaffected']==['B148 public cross-tenant law HELD','B154 real A all-signature-confirmations publisher consumer_missing']
assert head==subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=root,text=True).strip()
print(json.dumps({'outcome':'PASS_METADATA_ONLY','head':head,'tree':tree,'review':p,'review_sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'review_bytes':len(b),'complete_identity_refs_verified':len(seen),'closure_ids':[],'product_or_native_or_gate_execution':False,'source_claim':'conditional criteria adjudication; no final-candidate runtime proof'},ensure_ascii=False))
